_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the V Rising and V Rising BepInEx eggs in https://github.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: V Rising
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The vampire survival game: hunt for blood, avoid the sun and raise your castle. Installs the Windows dedicated server with SteamCMD, runs it under Wine and keeps it updated, with BepInEx for mods if you want it.
startup: if [ "{{MOD_LOADER}}" = bepinex ]; then if [ -f BepInEx/core/BepInEx.Unity.IL2CPP.dll ]; then export WINEDLLOVERRIDES="winhttp=n,b;$WINEDLLOVERRIDES"; else echo "BepInEx isn't installed, so the server starts without mods. Reinstall the server to install it."; fi; fi; wine ./VRisingServer.exe -persistentDataPath save-data -address 0.0.0.0 -gamePort {{SERVER_PORT}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# V Rising. Installs or updates the Windows dedicated server (Steam app 1829350)
# with SteamCMD, signed in anonymously, for Wine, and BepInEx when asked.
# Saves and settings in save-data and mods are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-1829350}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

mkdir -p save-data/Settings
# BepInEx, the mod loader, when Mod loader is bepinex. Its core files are
# replaced; its config and plugins folders are left alone. Turning it off
# keeps the files: the startup only loads BepInEx when it's on.
mods="${MOD_LOADER:-vanilla}"
extra=""
if [ "$mods" = bepinex ]; then
    ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
    pack=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" https://thunderstore.io/api/experimental/package/BepInEx/BepInExPack_V_Rising/) ||
        fail "Thunderstore can't be reached right now to download BepInEx. Reinstall to try again."
    bep=$(jq -r '.latest.version_number' <<<"$pack")
    if [ "$(cat BepInEx/.raptor-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$bep" ]; then
        echo "BepInEx $bep is already installed."
    else
        echo "Downloading BepInEx $bep"
        work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
        rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
        trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
        curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$work/pack.zip" "$(jq -r '.latest.download_url' <<<"$pack")"
        unzip -q "$work/pack.zip" 'BepInExPack_V_Rising/*' -d "$work" || fail "The BepInEx download is damaged. Reinstall to try again."
        src="$work/BepInExPack_V_Rising"
        mkdir -p BepInEx/plugins BepInEx/config
        rm -rf BepInEx/core dotnet
        cp -r "$src/BepInEx/core" BepInEx/core
        cp -r "$src/dotnet" dotnet
        cp -f "$src/winhttp.dll" "$src/doorstop_config.ini" "$src/.doorstop_version" .
        [ -f BepInEx/config/BepInEx.cfg ] || cp "$src/BepInEx/config/BepInEx.cfg" BepInEx/config/
        echo "$bep" > BepInEx/.raptor-version
    fi
    extra=" with BepInEx $bep"
fi
echo "Installed V Rising build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}$extra."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Description
variables.description: Shown in the server list and in chat when players join.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password players join with, or empty for none.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once.

variables.name: Admin slots
variables.description: Admins who can join even when the server is full.

variables.name: Game settings preset
variables.description: A preset of game settings, used when a new save is made; empty uses ServerGameSettings.json.

variables.name: Difficulty preset
variables.description: The difficulty, used when a new save is made; empty uses ServerGameSettings.json.

variables.name: Save
variables.description: The save to load, or create when there's none by that name.

variables.name: Autosaves kept
variables.description: How many autosaves to keep.

variables.name: Autosave interval
variables.description: Seconds between autosaves.

variables.name: Frame rate
variables.description: The server's target frame rate.

variables.name: Lower frame rate when empty
variables.description: Run at a lower frame rate while no one is on.

variables.name: Empty frame rate
variables.description: The frame rate while no one is on, if lowering it is on.

variables.name: Secure
variables.description: Turn on Valve Anti-Cheat: VAC-banned players can't join.

variables.name: List on Steam
variables.description: List the server in Steam's server list, which the player count also needs.

variables.name: List on Epic
variables.description: List the server in Epic's server list, which the game shows by default.

variables.name: Hide IP address
variables.description: Hide the address in Epic's list; players connect through relays.

variables.name: RCON
variables.description: Turn on remote admin over RCON.

variables.name: RCON password
variables.description: The password RCON clients sign in with.

variables.name: RCON port
variables.description: The TCP port for RCON; give it an allocation.

variables.name: Mod loader
variables.description: vanilla, or bepinex to load mods from BepInEx/plugins. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Query port
variables.description: The port Steam's server queries use; give it an allocation.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.

variables.name: Windows build
variables.description: Install the Windows version of the server, which runs under Wine.

variables.name: Wine logging
variables.description: What Wine logs; -all keeps its messages out of the console.
